description: Look up a company in a public business register. Pass a canonical identifier (company/registration number, VAT number) for an exact match, or a company name to search where the register supports it.

detail.description: full adds history, filings, and linked persons where the register keeps them (ORSR, RPO). Default: standard.

q.description: Canonical identifier (e.g. company number, VAT number) or company name
